abstract: Two hundred and sixty-five patients with malignant trophoblastic disease were admitted to the Southeastern Trophoblastic Disease Center at Duke University Medical Center between July 1966 and June 1976. Of these 165 patients, 20 had choriocarcinoma following a term gestation with a survival rate of 60% as compared to 95% survival rate for the remaining 245 patients. Previously described risk factors of initial human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) titer of greater than 100,000 IU/24 hr urine, duration of symptoms for more than 4 months, significant prior unsuccessful chemotherapy or cerebral or hepatic metastases identified the "poor prognosis" group. Post-term gestation "poor prognosis" patients had a significantly lower cure rate (47%), than other patients with "poor prognosis" for gestational trophoblastic disease (75%; P less than 0.05). Post-term gestation choriocarcinoma has a propensity for more extensive metastatic spread and would appear to be less responsive to conventional chemotherapy, which may be due to an altered immune response in these patients. This suggests that an antecedent term pregnancy should be added to the previously described high-risk factors for patients with malignant trophoblastic disease.
abstract_ja: 1966年7月から1976年6月の間に、デューク大学医療センターの妊娠性絨毛性疾患センターを受診した悪性妊娠性絨毛性疾患の患者265例を検討した。このうち165例中20例は正期妊娠後に絨毛癌を発症し、生存率は60%であった。残りの245例の生存率は95%であった。初回ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値が24時間尿中で10万IU超、症状持続期間が4か月超、化学療法への不応、または頭蓋内もしくは肝転移を有することが、既報の「予後不良」因子として同定されていた。正期妊娠後の「予後不良」群の治癒率は47%で、他の妊娠性絨毛性疾患の「予後不良」群(75%)より有意に低かった(P<0.05)。正期妊娠後の絨毛癌は転移の広がりが強い傾向があり、従来の化学療法への反応が乏しく、これは患者の免疫応答の変化によるものかもしれない。したがって、先行する正期妊娠を悪性妊娠性絨毛性疾患の既知の高リスク因子に加えるべきである。
